simple.meaning: Lemuel or Lemoel , a symbolic name of Solomon
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לְמוּאֵל (H3927) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לְמוּאֵל (Lᵉmûwʼêl) means Lemuel or Lemoel , a symbolic name of Solomon First listed occurrence: Prov 31 1.

definitions.short: Lemuel or Lemoel , a symbolic name of Solomon
definitions.full: H3927. Lemuel or Lemoel לְמוֺאֵל לְמוּאֵל, proper name, masculine king of Massa (probably, see מַשָּׂא ); ׳לְמו Prov 31:1 , ׳למוֺ 31:4 .
definitions.rootNote: or לְמוֹאֵל ; from 3926 and 410 ; (belonging) to God;
